page.overview:
Who is Bellow?

Bellow was a clone trooper who served in the 501st Legion of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Bellow served under Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and Clone Captain Rex during a mission to investigate Confederacy of Independent Systems activity on the planet Benglor in 22 BBY. During the mission, Bellow discovered parts of a B1-series battle droid while trekking through jungle with Skywalker and several other clones. After searching for more clues, Bellow was attacked by a creature that caught and ate him.

The clone trooper who adopted the name Bellow served in the 501st Legion of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Like all of the Republic's clone troopers, he was created and trained on the planet Kamino as a clone of the human bounty hunter Jango Fett. During the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, he served under Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and Clone Captain Rex on a mission to the planet Benglor in order to investigate Separatist activity there.

Bellow trekked through the hot jungle of Benglor with Skywalker, Rex, Hardcase, and another clone. As their search for the Separatists was proving unfruitful, Skywalker began considering ending the mission due to the extreme heat. Then, Hardcase discovered a green-colored slime on one of the nearby trees, which he alerted the others to as a potential clue.

Bellow then discovered a B1-series battle droid head in a sand mound, teasing Hardcase that he had found better evidence than him. As the clones discovered more parts of the droid, Skywalker realized the pieces had been purposefully left as a trail for them to find. However, before he could warn the others of the potential trap, Bellow discovered more of the slime and called out to the others.
